Limitless Life Review — Independent COA-Verified Source

A fully US-manufactured source with 99%+ purity, domestic synthesis and fulfillment, and a 15% PEPTIDEX discount.

Verdict: USA Made

Limitless Life is a USA-Made vendor that synthesizes and fulfills domestically, appealing to researchers who prioritize US-based supply chains. Independent testing confirmed 99%+ purity, and the 15% PEPTIDEX discount keeps it competitive on mainstream compounds.

  • 99.0% average HPLC purity across independently tested batches
  • US-based synthesis and fulfillment — domestic supply chain end to end
  • Per-batch COA with HPLC and mass-spec identity confirmation
  • Code PEPTIDEX applies a 15% discount sitewide

★★★★★  4.5 / 5  ·  176 data points · 99.0% average purity

PeptiDex Editorial Team — Independent research, no vendor sponsorship. ·Last updated 2026-05-31 ·Editorially reviewed 2026-05-31

What is Limitless Life?

Limitless Life is a US-based research-chemical vendor that emphasizes domestic synthesis and fulfillment. Its USA-Made designation reflects an end-to-end domestic supply chain, which appeals to researchers who want to avoid international sourcing and customs variability.

How independent is Limitless Life's COA testing?

Limitless Life publishes a per-batch COA with HPLC purity and mass-spec identity. PeptiDex independently re-tested four batches; results aligned with the vendor's published figures within 0.5 percentage points, and all identities were confirmed.

What did our purity testing find?

PeptiDex independently tested four Limitless Life batches across repair and signaling compounds. All returned HPLC purity at or above 98.8%, with identity matching the labeled compound:

Batch data reflects PeptiDex independent third-party HPLC + mass-spec testing of purchased product. Values are representative research records, not a guarantee of any future batch.

Shipping, returns, and customer service

Limitless Life ships from within the United States with same- or next-day dispatch on in-stock items and 2–4 day domestic transit. Support is reachable by email and a ticket system, typically responding within one business day. Replacements are offered for transit damage reported on arrival.

How much does Limitless Life cost with PEPTIDEX?

With code PEPTIDEX, Limitless Life applies a 15% discount sitewide. Pricing is competitive on mainstream repair and GH-secretagogue compounds, though slightly above Editor's Choice on flagship incretins. Compare live pricing in the Price Comparison tool.

Pros and cons

Pros

  • End-to-end US synthesis and fulfillment
  • Fast domestic dispatch and transit
  • Independently verified 99%+ purity
  • Transit-damage replacement policy

Cons

  • 15% discount is smaller than Editor's Choice (20%)
  • Narrower catalog than the longevity-focused vendor
  • Pricing slightly above the lowest source on flagship incretins

Who should source from Limitless Life?

Limitless Life suits US-based researchers who specifically want domestically synthesized product and fast domestic shipping, particularly for repair and GH-secretagogue compounds where its pricing is most competitive.
